name: organiser-picks
teaches: Organisers decide who plays: players ask the organiser for a spot, the organiser announces the team and picks replacements from the reserves. Who fills an open place is never switched from the chat: it is suggested to the organiser, with the messages behind it.

history.author: Callum Reid
history.text: Wednesday 8pm at Powerleague Mill Hill. Drop me a message if you fancy a game and I'll sort the team

history.text: Team for Wednesday: Tariq, Nathan, Ollie, Jamal, Rhys, Ben, Sami and me. Rest on the reserve list
